Data:Wings.scale.json.Label: Lepidoptery Display (Scale-centric)
Data:Wings.scale.json.Desc: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.

xexts.scrutiny: The thoraces and abdomens of these insects are crusted alarmingly with complex mouth-parts. A typed card reads FALCIDAE.

Data:Wings.winter.json.Label: Lepidoptery Display (Winter-centric)
Data:Wings.winter.json.Desc: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.

xexts.scrutiny: These insects are many-segmented, like centipedes, although their bodies are so tightly coiled this is not initially apparent. The wings look impractical, and indeed their edges bristle with claws. A typed card reads EXCETRIDAE.

Data:Winning.move.json.Label: Winning Move
Data:Winning.move.json.Desc: Those who've studied the Hours of the Edge often say the world is a war - the Corrivality. Every event that might happen differently is a battle in that war, a contention between alternate outcomes. The Wisdoms can sometimes show those battles might be won.

Data:Winter.json.label: Winter
Data:Winter.json.desc: ... [Winter is the principle of silence, of endings, and of those things that are not quite dead.]

Data:Winter.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Winter.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Wire.gold.json.Label: Wire (Gold)
Data:Wire.gold.json.Desc: The Lionsmith has sometimes been associated with this metal… as has the Hour called the Flowermaker.

xexts.scrutiny: The Flowermaker existed before the Intercalate, but it is far from certain that he existed long before the Intercalate - before the Forge of Days began to develop her interest in the Sun.

Data:Wire.orichalcum.json.Label: Wire (Orichalcum)
Data:Wire.orichalcum.json.Desc: A metal which alters its estate in every age, but in every age can be used to catalyse the azoth.

xexts.scrutiny: There is a sunset song which tells how in sea-stolen Ys, all the water-ewers were orichalcum, and all the window-panes were amber… [There are Scholar-level Forge recipes which can be used to craft this from another metal.]

There is a rare alloy called gervinite which is used for potent Knock-devices. It has some of the properties of silver. Would it be possible, perhaps, to use silver wire instead? It would be a Keeper-level recipe…

Data:Wire.tin.json.Label: Wire (Tin)
Data:Wire.tin.json.Desc: The white metal of the Sun-in-Rags.

Data:Wisdom.committed.json.label: Committed
Data:Wisdom.committed.json.desc: You've determined where this skill should belong, in the wide kingdoms of understanding. [This skill is now committed to the Wisdom marked on the card.]

Data:Wisp.agdistis.json.label: Agdistis' Wisp
Data:Wisp.agdistis.json.desc: A 'poor wisp' preserved by Agdistis from the Grunewald disaster. Cooing, mewing, warm to the touch. Notionally harmless. [Agdistis has asked you to place this in the Chrysalis that you can find in the Cucurbit, but you could destroy it in the furnace if you were suspicious.]

Data:Wisp.ehsan.json.label: Ehsan's Wisp
Data:Wisp.ehsan.json.desc: A 'poor wisp' preserved by Ehsan from the Grunewald disaster. Cooing, mewing, warm to the touch.  Notionally harmless. [Ehsan has asked you to place this in the Chrysalis that you can find in the Cucurbit, but you could destroy it in the furnace if you were suspicious.]

Data:Wisp.skin.agdistis.json.label: Agdistis' Wisp: Shed Skin
Data:Wisp.skin.agdistis.json.desc: The shed skin of a 'poor wisp' preserved by Agdistis from the Grunewald disaster. The wisp itself now resides in the Chrysalis. [Return this to Agdistis.]

Data:Wisp.skin.ehsan.json.label: Ehsan's Wisp: Shed Skin
Data:Wisp.skin.ehsan.json.desc: The shed skin of a 'poor wisp' preserved by Ehsan from the Grunewald disaster. The wisp itself now resides in the Chrysalis. [Return this to Ehsan.]

Data:Wisp.trace.agdistis.json.label: Agdistis' Wisp: Cindered Trace
Data:Wisp.trace.agdistis.json.desc: The charred remains of a 'poor wisp' preserved by Agdistis from the Grunewald disaster. It probably wasn't as harmless as it seemed... [Return this to Agdistis.]

Data:Wisp.trace.ehsan.json.label: Ehsan's Wisp: Cindered Trace
Data:Wisp.trace.ehsan.json.desc: The charred remains of a 'poor wisp' preserved by Ehsan from the Grunewald disaster.  It probably wasn't as harmless as it seemed... [Return this to Ehsan.]

Data:Witching.tisane.json.Label: Witching Tisane
Data:Witching.tisane.json.Desc: 'To mend a broken heart, to colour a pale soul.'

xexts.scrutiny: The taste is like a lingering kiss at the mouth's edge. [There are Prentice-level Grail recipes that can craft this.]

Data:Witchworms.desiccated.json.Label: Desiccated Witchworms
Data:Witchworms.desiccated.json.Desc: Nasty little things, but almost safe when they're this dead.

Data:Wood.json.label: Wood
Data:Wood.json.desc: The pillars of the sky, to some; to others, paper in waiting.

Data:Wooden.json.label: Made of Wood
Data:Wooden.json.desc: [Take this to a Workbench to render it into Wooden Scraps.]

Data:Work.edge.sweetbones.json.label: A Little Respect
Data:Work.edge.sweetbones.json.startdescription: <sprite name=edge> I am the Librarian of Hush House. I will question the villagers of Brancrug, and I will add whatever they tell me to my store of knowledge. [Or add a coin to find visitors seeking employment.]
Data:Work.edge.sweetbones.json.desc: @#mem.gossip|Just gossip; but even gossip is knowledge.#mem.fear|A story of the old things that still prowl the moors.#mem.foresight|Practical advice from practical people.#mem.hindsight|Every village has its tiny tragedies; today, I learnt another.#mem.regret|A half-hour chatting with someone uncomplicatedly happy. Could that have been me? Would I want that?#|I've learnt something. Something useful? Too early to tell.@

Data:Work.forge.sweetbones.json.label: Fixing and Mending
Data:Work.forge.sweetbones.json.startdescription: <sprite name=forge> There's not much work on offer in Brancrug, but I can find sixpence worth of odd jobs. [Or add a coin to find visitors seeking employment.]
Data:Work.forge.sweetbones.json.desc: As they used to say in my youth, 'The day is done, and so am I; but I've earned my pay.'

Data:Work.heart.sweetbones.json.label: Manual Labour
Data:Work.heart.sweetbones.json.startdescription: <sprite name=heart> There's not much work on offer in Brancrug, but I can find sixpence worth of odd jobs. [Or add a coin to find visitors seeking employment.]
Data:Work.heart.sweetbones.json.desc: As they used to say in my youth, 'The day is done, and so am I; but I've earned my pay.'

Data:Work.heart.sweetbones.numa.json.label: Uncanny Labours
Data:Work.heart.sweetbones.numa.json.startdescription: The inn is crowded with Numa's heralds and pilgrims. They will be gone by morning. Until then, I could offer my services for payment. I might regret it.
Data:Work.heart.sweetbones.numa.json.desc: Afterwards I don't remember what work I performed, except in scents and sensations - leaf-mould, a rhythmic musical clicking like melodious castanets, soft blue flame like antique gaslight. And cold; I remember that where we went, it was cold.

Data:Work.lantern.sweetbones.json.label: Help with Letters
Data:Work.lantern.sweetbones.json.startdescription: <sprite name=lantern> I could offer help with correspondence and arithmetic. There's no school in Brancrug, and not everyone here knows their letters. [Or add a coin to find visitors seeking employment.]
Data:Work.lantern.sweetbones.json.desc: An afternoon spent profitably, reading newspapers to the curious, writing affectionate letters for the lonely, steering farmers through the requirements of the Ministry of Agriculture.

Data:Work.moth.sweetbones.json.label: Fortune-Telling
Data:Work.moth.sweetbones.json.startdescription: <sprite name=moth> I've garnered enough mystique to tell fortunes for pennies. Undignified, perhaps, for the Librarian of Hush House, but times are hard. [Or add a coin to find visitors seeking employment.]
Data:Work.moth.sweetbones.json.desc: The fortunes I tell may be true, and they may be real. The money, at least, is real.

Data:Workstation.json.label: Workstation
Data:Workstation.json.desc: ['The reward of a thing well done - is to have done it.' - Emerson]

Data:Workstationhasaspect.json.label: Consecrated
Data:Workstationhasaspect.json.desc: [This place has been consecrated in a way that means it provides Aspect natively.]

Data:World.beachcombing.json.label: Beachcombing
Data:World.beachcombing.json.desc: Take a long walk along the ocean's side. If I know what to look for, I might find something the ocean has forsaken.

Data:World.caves.json.label: The Sea-Caves
Data:World.caves.json.desc: Splash cautiously through the shallower tunnels.

Data:World.corals.deeplight.delegacizing.label: A Merciful Alteration
Data:World.corals.deeplight.delegacizing.startdescription: [There's an aberration here. Hit Start, and the problem will permanently resolve itself. You might need to put a Soul element in to make Start available, but you won't lose or fatigue anything.]

Data:World.corals.deeplight.json.label: Deeplight Corals
Data:World.corals.deeplight.json.desc: Where the wild few traffic with the tides.

Data:World.moor.json.label: A Walk on the Moor
Data:World.moor.json.desc: Clamber up into the long reaches of the moors behind the village. Lean into the wind's fluttering fist. If I know what to look for, I might find something among the rocks.

Data:World.nests.json.label: The Gull-Colony
Data:World.nests.json.desc: Steal eggs from the sea-birds, or find what the sea-birds have stolen.

Data:World.sea.beach.json.label: Sea's Edge
Data:World.sea.beach.json.desc: The Sea is always hungry; the Sea never sleeps; the Sea accepts offerings. [Discard objects here; release beasts; or go for a swim.]

Data:World.sea.boathouse.json.label: Brancrug Boathouse
Data:World.sea.boathouse.json.desc: The boat is gone, the Sea remains. That is, of course, the way it usually works. [Discard objects here; release beasts; or go for a swim.]

Data:World.sea.crane.json.label: Loading Dock Crane
Data:World.sea.crane.json.comments: The only sea workstation which doesn't accept Abilities - prisoners couldn't swim to freedom.
Data:World.sea.crane.json.desc: Long ago, this was the route by which provisions entered the gaol, and by which prisoners failed to escape. [Discard objects here, or release beasts.]

Data:World.tree.gate.json.label: The Earl's Yew
Data:World.tree.gate.json.desc: Since the Conquest, this has been waiting for you. The irreverent might even call it a you tree.
